title: Grateful Dead Live at Old Renaissance Faire Grounds on 1972-08-27
source: Master Betty reel > PCM > DAT > ZA2 > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a legendary 1972 show featuring a smoking Dark Star, blazing China > Rider and other classic gems.
ai_review.review: Fans hail this recording as one of the greatest Dead shows ever, with Dark Star, China > Rider, Playin' in the Band, Bird Song and Sing Me Back Home all cited as near‑perfect performances. The soundboard source is praised for its clarity and balance, making the high‑energy jam sessions fully enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, consistently praising both the musical performance (exceptional energy and standout songs) and the pristine soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nice sounding source; crisp, clear mix with no reported dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first‑set opener with Promised Land, hot China > Rider mid‑set and a powerful Bertha closer; the second set maintains high intensity throughout.
